capabilities: Convert typed shortcuts into Unicode symbols on Space
Insert arrows, math operators, and Greek letters from LaTeX-style commands
Convert superscripts and subscripts after ^ or _
Restore original text via Undo or Backspace after conversion
extras: Conversion is skipped in code, math formulas, properties, HTML, comments, embeds, and link URLs; braces like x_{i} are not supported.
problem: Typing Unicode symbols such as arrows, subscripts, and Greek letters normally requires copying them or memorizing alt codes.
summary: Symbol inserter that converts typed shortcuts like ->, ^i, or \alpha into Unicode symbols when you press Space.
